title: Interop day: a by-value invalid proposal, if the §5.3 gap has an answer
description: Jason (238475) and we (238481) agree protocol-07 §5.3 invalidProposals (ProposalRefs) cannot name a proposal committed by value. If the WG or the two of us settle how (index into Commit.proposals, empty list meaning by value, or a #190 refusal reason), add a joint vector for it and implement the answer in mimid's hub (which answers notAllowed for every refusal today, decision mimid-1wgh.6.55).
